_doc: Experiment of Ch. 8 (application E on a 2x2 manycore, pkt-sim/software/ucx-os/app/weird_a.c). PE labels are Y-X, the order of the stored log A; the analysis swaps X and Y of X-Y logs (manycore_pe.sv of this tree) automatically. Times in seconds of platform time or cycles of clock_hz (F_CLK, 500 MHz in run F); the RUN_INFO of a simulation (simulate.sh f_clk_hz) overrides clock_hz.
_application_doc: CSV of application E (path relative to this file). Its creation rows (order of ucx_task_add in app_main of weird_a.c, without the idle task) are the source of the dispatch order of the analysis: rttools/bench_t/estimate.py dispatch_order (round robin in creation order from the idle task). pe_tasks below decodes the task ids of the log (id 0 = IDLE, then the creation order) and must follow the creation rows; the analysis stops otherwise.

join._doc: rule per_producer: J runs iteration k after the k-th packet of each tag (weird_a.c of this tree); any3: J joins any packets_per_iteration packets (weird_a.c of the stored logs A to E; the Makefiles select it for these logs).

estimate._doc: Characterized task costs of rttools/bench_t/main.py: tasks of each cluster (listed in the dispatch order that the kernel rule gives; the analysis takes the order from the creation rows of the application, not from this list), cost in scale of the ORCA RT-Tools reference (10 times weird_a.c), scheduler cost included in each cost. rttools/bench_t/estimate.py runs the ORT/BENCH engine on each sequence.

instrumentation._doc: Bound of the instrumentation writes in the measured CPU time (rttools/paper/instrumentation.py). callees: functions of device/cacc.c that write the registers of manycore_pe.sv. events: kind of logged event -> function that writes its register (set_counter_2 prints `scheduled`, set_counter_3 `->`, set_counter_4 `<-`), in charge order. cycles: cycles per instruction class of the HF-RISC core on the bus of manycore_pe.sv (no stall, no wait state), measured by pkt-sim/tests/rtl/tb_cpu_cycles.vhd.

task_graph._doc: Edges of application E (apps/synthetic-app-e/synthetic-app-e.txt), for the phase index of each task and the response bound.

thesis._doc: Values printed in the ORCA RT-Tools reference (Ch. 8), in the units the ORCA RT-Tools reference states.
